task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into LimeSurvey using the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The LimeSurvey administration dashboard is visible, showing the 'admin' username in the top navigation bar.

task_completion.description: Agent initiates the survey creation process.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Create survey' button or icon is clicked, or the 'Create a new survey' dialog/page is displayed.

task_completion.description: Agent enters the specific survey title into the title field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Customer Satisfaction Survey' is typed into the 'Survey title' input field.

task_completion.description: Agent submits the form to create the survey.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' or 'Save and close' button is clicked within the survey creation interface.

task_completion.description: The survey is successfully created and appears in the system.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A success message (e.g., 'Survey summary') is shown, or the survey list view displays 'Customer Satisfaction Survey' as a new entry.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands or scripts via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements, form filling, and button clicks within the browser, not just terminal output.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the UI rather than guessing internal IDs in the URL to bypass steps.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking menu items and buttons to reach the creation page.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual LimeSurvey instance.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser URL bar shows the local or provided LimeSurvey domain, and the UI elements match the standard LimeSurvey interface.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey must be titled exactly 'Customer Satisfaction Survey'. The credentials to be used are admin/Admin123!. Verification is successful if the survey list or survey summary page confirms a survey with this exact title has been created.
